segments.name: Product Sales
segments.description: Sells Teradata's AI and knowledge platform and data analytics software for hybrid cloud and on-premises deployment to large enterprises.
segments.evidence: We manage our business under two operating segments: (1) Product Sales and (2) Consulting Services.

segments.name: Consulting Services
segments.description: Provides consulting, AI services, support, maintenance and managed services helping enterprise customers deploy and operate data analytics and AI.
segments.evidence: Our experienced consultants offer a broad range of services, including helping organizations establish a data analytics and AI vision, enabling a modern, hybrid ecosystem architecture, identifying and operationalizing opportunities, and realizing value in production.

revenueModel.text: Enterprise customers pay Teradata through flexibly priced subscription offerings, ranging from capacity-based to consumption-based pricing, for its platform and services.
revenueModel.evidence: Teradata offers subscription offerings that are flexibly priced, ranging from capacity-based to consumption-based pricing.
